water.name: Land
water.rule: At least 4 of the hex's 7 sample points (centre + 6) fall on the Ministry of the Interior county outlines or Natural Earth country outlines, unless the centre is sea and the SRTM15+ mean is at or below sea level, or at least half its SRTM15+ samples are (lagoons and tidal flats stay water).

water.name: Ocean
water.rule: Sea deeper than 200 m and not next to land.

water.name: Coast
water.rule: Sea next to a land hex, or shallower than 200 m (SRTM15+ mean).

water.name: Lake
water.rule: Water hex (most of its 7 sample points off land) with Natural Earth 1:50m lake points that outnumber sea points, or above sea level.

relief.name: Flat
relief.rule: Neither hills nor mountains: plains, and tablelands (台地) whose ground is high but level (spread under 30 m).

relief.name: Hills
relief.rule: Elevation standard deviation inside the hex ≥ 85 m, or mean elevation ≥ 100 m with a standard deviation ≥ 30 m.

relief.name: Mountains
relief.rule: Mean elevation ≥ 1,000 m (the official threshold for 山地), or elevation standard deviation ≥ 260 m.

cover.name: None
cover.rule: Water, foreign land, or no WorldCover land pixels.

cover.name: Broadleaf forest
cover.rule: Tree cover (10) is the largest group and the hex's mean elevation is under 1,500 m: the evergreen broadleaf forests of the lowlands and foothills.

cover.name: Conifer forest
cover.rule: Tree cover is the largest group and the mean elevation is 2,500 m or more: hemlock, spruce and fir.

cover.name: Mixed forest
cover.rule: Tree cover is the largest group and the mean elevation is 1,500-2,500 m: oak and laurel mixed with conifers.

cover.name: Grassland
cover.rule: Grassland (30) is the largest group: alpine dwarf-bamboo meadows, riverside grass, parks and lawns.

cover.name: Pasture
cover.rule: Not mapped: WorldCover has no pasture class (grazed land falls under grassland or cropland).

cover.name: Cropland
cover.rule: Cropland (40) is the largest group: rice paddies, dry fields and orchards.

cover.name: Wetland
cover.rule: Herbaceous wetland (90) plus mangroves (95) is the largest group.

cover.name: Urban
cover.rule: Built-up (50) is ≥ 30% of the hex's land, whatever else is there.

cover.name: Barren
cover.rule: Bare or sparse vegetation (60) plus moss and lichen (100) is the largest group: high ridges, landslide scars and the wide gravel beds of Taiwan's rivers.

cover.name: Ice & snow
cover.rule: Snow and ice (70) is the largest group.

notes.water: Ministry of the Interior county outlines (taiwan-atlas) and Natural Earth 1:50m country outlines (the Fujian coast) don't meet exactly. A sea hex whose SRTM15+ mean is above sea level (and under half of its samples below it) becomes land when at least 4 of its 6 neighbours are land, or when it touches both Taiwanese and foreign land; it takes the neighbours' majority owner. Reservoirs narrower than half a hex are land. Lagoons and tidal flats stay water when the hex centre is sea and its SRTM15+ mean is at or below sea level or at least half of its samples are. A sea hex's elevation is the mean of its SRTM15+ samples below sea level (its water depth). Pratas and the Spratlys (Kaohsiung's Cijin District) are outside the map window.
notes.relief: From SRTM15+ samples (15 arc-seconds, ~460 m apart, about 49 per hex) with altitude ≥ -100 m, so bays and sea floor don't count; all samples are used if none qualify. Water hexes are always flat.
notes.cover: From ESA WorldCover 2021 (10 m, read at its 1/16 overview: ~148 m pixels), sampled on a lattice inside each Taiwanese hex (about 500 points). Permanent water (80) and no-data pixels are ignored; shares are of the remaining land points, rounded to whole percent, and the urban threshold is applied to the rounded built-up share. WorldCover has a single tree-cover class, so the forest type follows Taiwan's altitudinal vegetation zones by the hex's mean elevation (broadleaf under 1,500 m, mixed to 2,500 m, conifer above). It has no pasture class, so pasture is 0 everywhere. Foreign hexes (the Fujian coast) have cover 0 (none).
